column1: # Godot 4.7.1 ground truth for the rainbow bar, the rainbow frame and the skill tree's sky: the real
# scripts/systems/rainbow_bar.gd, rainbow_frame.gd and skill_tree_sky.gd compiled from their own source with only their
# draw calls (and the bar's global random draws) renamed to recorders, generated 2026-10-28 by
